title: Mykolaiv Shipyard
summary: Mykolaiv Shipyard refers to several shipbuilding facilities located in the [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] city of Mykolaiv, which is significant for its maritime industry.

sections.heading: Black Sea Shipyard
paragraphs: The Black Sea Shipyard, also recognized as [[mykolaiv|Nikolayev]] South Shipyard, has been designated as Soviet Shipyard No. 444 and Shipyard No. 198. This facility plays a crucial role in the shipbuilding sector of [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Mykolayiv Shipyard
paragraphs: Known as Nikolaev North Shipyard and previously referred to as Soviet Shipyard No. 200, Mykolayiv Shipyard contributes to the maritime capabilities of Ukraine.

sections.heading: Okean Shipyard
paragraphs: Okean Shipyard is a merchant shipyard that is part of the shipbuilding landscape in Mykolaiv, supporting the commercial maritime sector [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Nibulon Shipbuilding-Shiprepair Plant
paragraphs: Operated by the Nibulon agro-logistics company, the Nibulon Shipbuilding-Shiprepair Plant is another significant facility in Mykolaiv, emphasizing the integration of agriculture and maritime industries in Ukraine.
